about: Where RLMM Setup gets everything. Setup reads this file from GitHub (main) at every run, so a change pushed here
reaches every install, including RLMM-Setup.exe copies already out there, without a new release.
Test a change before pushing by running install.ps1 from your copy of the repo: it then uses this sources.json and
the local templates/ and assets/ folders instead of GitHub's.
Components install in the order listed. The keys of 'github' and 'classes' components are fixed (install.ps1
has a step for each); 'folder' components are generic, so one can be added for a new folder. GitHub components
install their latest commit; add "ref" (a branch, tag or commit) to pin one, or change "repo" to use a fork.
'folder' components are plain files in a folder of this repo (or of "repo" at "ref", if given). Each file goes
where the first matching 'install' rule says (paths relative to the UDK folder); files no rule matches, like a
README, are not installed. To update one, replace the file and push: no sizes or checksums to edit.
Raise 'format' only when install.ps1 changes how it reads this file.
Epic's UDK 2015-02 installer. Mirrors are tried in order: Google Drive (~50 MB/s) first; archive.org caps
each user at about 1 MB/s, so it is the fallback. 'eula' locates EULA.INT.rtf inside the installer, so
setup can show the license before the 2 GB download.

components.title: Dummy classes
about: Two repos merged. repo: hand-made for the editor (sprites for spawns and boost pads, the goal and FX
subobjects the stadiums and templates reference). generated: generated from the current Rocket League
build (~1,400 more classes). repo wins where both have a class, except the files in useGenerated, and
setup switches any other file that breaks the compile to the generated one. drop: repo-only classes
Rocket League no longer has. Raise 'merge' after changing these rules, so installs re-merge.

components.title: Not So Dummy Assets
components.about: Packages in Git LFS, fetched file by file; 'fallback' is a full zip used when that fails.

components.title: Misc assets (boost pads, crossbar)
components.about: Aceman3000's Misc packages (boost pad effects, physical materials incl. goal posts and crossbar).

components.title: Dummy assets (gap fill)
components.about: Only packages that no other content folder has are installed, so no package name is ambiguous.

components.title: Map templates
about: File > New Level templates. See templates/README.md; tools/templates.py check / fix keeps them
right (cubemap capture time, New Level entries, names). 'backup' keeps the UDK files they replace.
